programmeProvider.registryName: Bachelor International Land and Water Management

comparator.name: International Land and Water Management
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official handbook defines 180 EC: a 117-EC named compulsory common part, a 3-EC mathematics/statistics restricted choice, an 18-EC internship, a 12-EC thesis and 30 EC of open electives. Mathematics Applied: Introduction is selected by the official-order tie-break. Current programme material confirms the integrated biophysical, socio-economic, policy and design identity.

BSc Thesis International Land and Water Management

notes.text: WUR offers a dedicated international land-and-water curriculum with hydrology, hydraulics, irrigation, soils, engineering design, field practice, an internship and a thesis.
